reels.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses the memory bottleneck of recurrent states in linear attention, a perfect candidate for visualizing 'streaming' data flow—a high-performing visual motif for 3b1b-style content.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do AI models get 'forgetful' as they get longer—and how can we shrink their memory without losing a single thought?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Compressing a giant, sprawling library book into a tiny, high-density QR code that only expands when you look at a specific page.
